$comment: LDAP / Active Directory source template — INBOUND user-federation source.
Registers a corporate LDAP/AD directory as a Keycloak user-storage provider
so users sign in with directory credentials and are imported + linked by
verified email. Feed to the Keycloak Admin REST API:
with an Authorization: Bearer <admin token> header.
The bind password is NEVER stored here. {{ldap_bind_password}} is resolved
from the KV config store at apply time by the tooling. Keycloak component
config values are arrays of strings (MultivaluedHashMap).
name: corp-ldap

$attribute_notes: userPrincipalName + mail feed verified-email auto-linking. AD marks
directory mail as authoritative, so trustEmail is enabled below.
